mapper.sql: SELECT d.id, d.project_id, d.task_id, d.title, d.creator_id, u.username AS creator_username, u.real_name AS creator_real_name, t.task_no AS task_no, t.title AS task_title, d.comment_count, d.last_comment_at, d.created_at FROM discussion d JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = d.creator_id LEFT JOIN task t ON t.id = d.task_id

SELECT c.id, c.discussion_id, c.user_id, u.username AS user_username, u.real_name AS user_real_name, c.content, c.mentions AS mentions, c.documents AS documents, c.created_at FROM comment c JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.user_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO discussion (project_id, task_id, title, creator_id) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{taskId}, #{title}, #{creatorId})
mapper.update: UPDATE discussion SET comment_count = comment_count + 1, last_comment_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (discussion_id, user_id, content, mentions, documents) VALUES (#{discussionId}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{mentions, typeHandler=org.miniteam.pms.common.mybatis.JsonLongListTypeHandler}, #{documents, typeHandler=org.miniteam.pms.common.mybatis.JsonLongListTypeHandler})
